message.content: In one of the conversations, MalfurionStormrage suggested that a community gathering would be a great way to enjoy the new garden together, emphasizing that it would serve as a wonderful place for everyone to gather and enjoy nature. He mentioned that they could set up a little area for children, perhaps including crafts or simple games, to keep things lively and entertaining. Additionally, he proposed having snacks and drinks available, which could be a nice opportunity for a casual get-together. Overall, MalfurionStormrage sees the gathering as a chance to celebrate the completion of the garden and to foster a sense of community.
